description: AMF-approved SGP since 2014 (approval GP-14000035), France's leading private forestry-investment manager: 650+ forests / 73,000 hectares across Europe (France, Romania, Germany, Sweden, Slovakia, Baltics, Ireland), ~24,000 individual and institutional investors, ~50 staff. Has diversified beyond forestry/vineyards/agricultural land into real-estate fund-of-funds (temporary usufruct of SCPI shares), broadening its asset-class footprint. Led by President Guillaume Toussaint and Directeur General Arnaud Filhol (co-founders, previously at La Societe d'Investissement Forestier).
